title: Do Theorem Provers Need Theorem-Proving Agents? mini-Lean-agent: A Coding-Agent Baseline for Lean
abstract: arXiv:2610.17331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: General-purpose coding agents use standard shell and file interactions, yet formal theorem-proving agents often rely on specialized, ad-hoc tooling. This makes it difficult to determine which components of theorem-proving agents provide benchmark gains: an improved base model, a specialized harness, a specific tool, or a combination of any of them. We introduce mini-Lean-agent, a deliberately minimal agent for Lean tasks whose only model-visible tool is bash. The model must use bash to inspect and edit the repository, search local libraries, invoke Lean, and manage its own intermediate work, while a separate trusted evaluator verifies the final artifact. We compare mini-Lean-agent against AxProverBase and Numina-Lean-Agent on the Putnam 2025 benchmark. Experiments with Gemini 3.8 Flash as the base model show that mini-Lean-agent solves 7/12 problems at \$2 per problem limit, compared with AxProverBase's 4/12. With Astra as the base model

translated_title: 定理证明器需要定理证明智能体吗？mini-Lean-agent：一个面向Lean的编码智能体基线
translated_abstract: 通用编码智能体使用标准的shell和文件交互，而形式化定理证明智能体往往依赖专门的、临时定制的工具。这使得很难确定定理证明智能体中哪些组件带来了基准测试上的提升：是改进的基础模型、专门的框架、特定的工具，还是它们的某种组合。我们提出了mini-Lean-agent，这是一个刻意保持极简的Lean任务智能体，其唯一对模型可见的工具就是bash。模型必须使用bash来检查和编辑代码仓库、搜索本地库、调用Lean并管理自己的中间工作，同时由一个独立且可信的评估器来验证最终产物。我们在Putnam 2025基准上将mini-Lean-agent与AxProverBase和Numina-Lean-Agent进行了比较。以Gemini 3.8 Flash作为基础模型的实验表明，mini-Lean-agent在每题2美元的预算限制下解决了12道题中的7道，而AxProverBase仅解决了12道中的4道。以Astra作为基础模型
tldr: 提出了一个仅使用bash作为唯一工具的极简Lean定理证明智能体，在Putnam 2025基准上以更低成本超越了依赖专门工具的定理证明智能体，表明专用工具可能并非必要。
en_tdlr: We introduce mini-Lean-agent, a deliberately minimal coding agent with bash as its only tool, which outperforms specialized theorem-proving agents on the Putnam 2025 benchmark at lower cost, suggesting specialized tooling may be unnecessary.
